systems.name: 6.1 Balloon Vehicle System
systems.notes: Hot air balloons provide vertical traversal to reach floating islands. Physics are gentle and wind-driven from the existing weather system. Fuel is coal or steam canisters. Multiplayer: single balloon entity with host physics.

tasks.notes: Simple buoyancy model; no complex aerodynamics.

tasks.text: Wind vector from weather system affects movement
tasks.notes: Use existing weather wind direction; balloon can angle against it.
Burn fuel to ascend or maintain altitude; drift is free.

tasks.text: Multiplayer: single entity, all boardable, host physics
tasks.notes: One balloon per party; host simulates, clients interpolate.

systems.name: 6.2 Construction & Deployment
systems.notes: Balloon crafted at Bub's camp via streamlined crafting. Placed as a 3D structure; interacting launches it. Uses custom model from Phase 1.

tasks.text: Craft balloon at Bub's camp, place as 3D structure
tasks.notes: Requires specific materials; placed like any block/model.
Activation begins physics simulation; anchor tether to camp optional.

systems.name: 6.3 Floating Island Integration
systems.notes: Floating islands already generate; balloon provides access. No new world gen needed. Flag planting from Phase 7 can be tied to islands.

tasks.text: Already generating, no changes needed; balloon enables access
